title: Capitalization Is Not Resilience
summary: From a ratio through asset quality, loss absorbency, leverage, liquidity, funding, concentration, operational continuity, stress, recovery and resolvability.
map_question: What records are required before capitalization is not resilience can support a bounded financial-governance decision?
interpretation_boundary: This map does not establish financial inclusion, productive allocation, durable wealth, resilience, monetary legitimacy, financial stability, intervention, guarantee, resolution, score, rank, or receipt.

nodes.note: Credit availability is not productive allocation.

nodes.note: Asset prices and capitalization are not outcomes.

nodes.label: Monetary policy, systemic risk, resolution, guarantees, and democratic finance
nodes.note: Intervention and innovation are not stability or legitimacy.
